messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway in eu-central-1. 5m error rate > 12%. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/eu-central-gateway

pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @sara (SRE) — escalation to P1 if not acked in 2m

sara: acked. looking into it now. grabbing runbook + logs.

mike: seeing a spike in 502/504s from gateway -> model-proxy upstream in eu-central. errors show `upstream prematurely closed connection` in nginx logs.

leila: customer-impact: initial alert from synthetic tests in eu-central, corroborated by elevated 5xx in infra logs. Support queue shows ~30 tickets in last 15m, mostly autocomplete and chat endpoints.

sara: quick triage commands:
```bash
# health check to edge
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# check gateway pods
kubectl get pods -n production -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
# tail last 200 lines of gateway log
kubectl logs -n production deployment/inference-gateway --tail=200
```

mike: output from curl shows a bunch of 502s. kubectl shows several gateway pods in CrashLoopBackOff with restarts around 22:03 UTC.

sara: logs snippet:
```
2026-02-18T22:02:58Z gateway[8]: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.12.34.56
2026-02-18T22:03:01Z gateway[8]: 502 "Bad Gateway" for request /v1/generate
```

james: could be model-proxyOOM or connection storm to a few overloaded model replicas. checking model-proxy and pod memory usage.

leila: checking model metrics — host-level OOM or kernel kill?

mike: model-proxy pods look healthy but we have a very tight connection pool setting getting exhausted. I can temporarily increase pool size and reduce keepalive idle timeout to reduce churn.

sara: while Mike adjusts pool, let's reduce traffic to eu-central and route to us-west to limit customer impact. plan: set regional weight eu-central -> 0.4, us-west -> 0.6. also enable gateway circuit-breaker on eu-central to 5xx threshold 10%.

mike: running traffic-router command now:
```bash
traffic-router set-weight --region eu-central-1 --weight 0.4 --dry-run=false --reason "mitigate elevated 5xx"
traffic-router set-weight --region us-west-2 --weight 0.6 --reason "mitigate eu-central outage"
```

mike: done. control plane confirms new weights. routing logs show gradual shift over 60s.

support-bot: Noted: routing change will affect EU customers. Sending proactive message to affected customers list.

leila: after reroute, 5xx rate in eu-central dropped to ~6% and overall global errors down to 3%. us-west CPU moved up ~8%.

james: I scaled model-proxy pool and bumped gateway max connections. commands:
```bash
kubectl scale deployment/model-proxy -n production --replicas=12
kubectl patch deployment/inference-gateway -n production -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONN","value":"20000"}]}]}}}}'
```

sara: quick sanity curl to endpoints routed to us-west and eu-central:
```bash
curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/health -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} eu:%{time_total}\n"
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -H "X-Region: us-west-2" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} us:%{time_total}\n"
```

mike: health OK from us-west checks, eu still returning occasional 502s but much improved.

leila: customer impact estimate updated: ~12% of EU traffic experienced failures during 21:58–22:06 UTC peak. Roughly 2.3k requests/min failed at peak. Top affected customers: AcmeSearch, NotaCorp, FlowAI (Contact SAs alerted).

sara: summarizing mitigation so far:
- Reduced eu-central traffic weight 0.4 -> 0.4 (routed remainder to us-west)
- Scaled model-proxy and gateway replicas
- Increased connection pool / max_conn
- Enabled circuit breaker fallback (threshold 10%)
- Support proactively messaged top affected customers

sara: handing off to @james for overnight monitoring and follow-up postmortem. state: partially mitigated, region stabilized but still under observation. please keep routing at shifted weights until we confirm root cause and validate a safe rollback plan.

james: taking over — will monitor for 3h, keep SRE rotation informed. Notes for handoff:
- watch gateway 5xx metric: grafana panel "gateway:5xx_rate"
- check pod restarts: `kubectl get pods -n production -l app=inference-gateway -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount`
- don't rollback weights until 1h of stable 5xx <1% in eu-central

sara: also created incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=INC-3421 and flagged for SEV review. please capture any config changes for the postmortem.

leila: opened support ticket batch to customers and logged impacted customer IDs into the incident doc.

james: acknowledged. will start a brief RCA capture and invite owners (mike, leila, sara) to the postmortem.

sara: thanks team. I’m going offline for the night but reachable if pager escalates. leaving the channel in a steady state. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P2 mitigation applied; monitoring continues. If any regression occurs, page on-call.
